modules.purpose: native primitives collections file stream process clock builtin
modules.ownership: Module policy: scalar values or explicit native handles; read the matching builtin/FFI contract.
modules.limits: Per-primitive catalog/platform limits; managed storage uses tracing GC.

modules.purpose: directory files filesystem enumerate walk metadata каталог файлы обход
modules.ownership: Module policy: Scan copies share progress/close; close incremental scans on every exit; walk closes scans.
modules.limits: Windows/Linux; no link descent; explicit depth/entry budgets; OS order is unspecified.

modules.purpose: JSON selective streaming validate skip ignored huge numbers NDJSON JSON-reader
modules.ownership: Module policy: Reader aliases share progress; Number/string slices retain immutable backing input.
modules.limits: UTF-8 buffer <=16 MiB, depth <=4096, values <=1000000; skip still validates syntax.

modules.purpose: JSON tree decode field array object number typed path
modules.ownership: Module policy: Array/Object contain shared mutable List payloads; ordinary shallow value copies.
modules.limits: Legacy bounded tree and numeric ranges; use json_stream for huge ignored numbers.

modules.purpose: HTTP HTTPS client curl request deadline timeout body headers network сеть
modules.ownership: Module policy: Exchange owns supervised process/temp files; cancel/drain to terminal then release.
modules.limits: Windows trusted curl 8.4+; curl_transfer preserves exact transfer timeout with bounded helper overhead.

modules.purpose: file read binary bytes text atomic write filesystem files файлы
modules.ownership: Module policy: immutable returned bytes; atomic publication owns temporary files and cleanup.
modules.limits: Legacy bounded reads <=256 MiB; text validates UTF-8; close/cleanup failures remain typed.

modules.purpose: path filesystem resource executable join parent directory путь
modules.ownership: Module policy: public String record; validation is not proof of OS identity or containment.
modules.limits: Nonempty/NUL/UTF-8 validation; preserve platform path rules.

modules.purpose: text UTF-8 bytes encode decode validate builder string
modules.ownership: Module policy: immutable String backing; builders share mutable storage; open Text revalidated.
modules.limits: Explicit byte/codepoint and builder limits; invalid UTF-8 has an offset.

modules.purpose: list copy reverse stable sort strings numbers collections
modules.ownership: Module policy: independent outer result list; nested mutable payloads remain shared.
modules.limits: State effect; byte string order, NaNs last, signed zeros stable.

modules.purpose: Result typed error transform map context failure
modules.ownership: Module policy: ordinary payload copies/aliases; map_error calls its callback only for Err.
modules.limits: Callback effects propagate; explain intentionally replaces the cause with String.

modules.purpose: lines text stream newline LF CRLF NDJSON reader
modules.ownership: Module policy: Reader/pull aliases share cursors; callback failures are sticky.
modules.limits: Legacy total <=256 MiB; CR is retained; explicit line/chunk bounds; String errors.

modules.purpose: CLI command arguments flags options positional parse
modules.ownership: Module policy: returned Dict/List are public shared mutable values; input arguments unchanged.
modules.limits: Unknown/duplicate flags reject; -- ends option parsing; typed bounds are application policy.

modules.purpose: configuration config JSON typed fields validate
modules.ownership: Module policy: public mutable members; lookups defensively validate shared input.
modules.limits: Typed missing/type/unknown/duplicate/text errors; bounded JSON tree.

modules.purpose: test named assertion table cases expected results
modules.ownership: Module policy: Case payloads follow ordinary value/alias rules.
modules.limits: Specify independent expected values; check is not execution.

modules.purpose: services dependency injection file process clock entropy memory test doubles
modules.ownership: Module policy: explicitly selected OS/memory implementations; memory stores share state.
modules.limits: Use declared interface effects and platform-specific OS adapters.

modules.purpose: replay transcript deterministic services record test
modules.ownership: Module policy: explicit transcript/cursor ownership; finish verifies complete consumption.
modules.limits: Typed events, bounded service responses; not ambient OS replay.

modules.purpose: process execute command supervised worker cancellation job
modules.ownership: Module policy: owned jobs/files; copies share progress; cancel then drain/release.
modules.limits: Windows supervised OS adapter; explicit argv/output/deadline bounds.

modules.purpose: event loop scheduling continuations poll completion
modules.ownership: Module policy: host-driven queues own continuations until completion.
modules.limits: Bounded scheduler, not native worker threads; explicit tick/shutdown.

modules.purpose: async task await fiber suspension
modules.ownership: Module policy: task copies share identity and suspension state.
modules.limits: Windows fibers; host lifecycle; no arbitrary blocking io inside async.

modules.purpose: task group structured cancellation scope children drain
modules.ownership: Module policy: Scope owns child hierarchy; terminal outcomes wait for cleanup.
modules.limits: Windows driven async runtime; explicit shutdown and tick until idle.

modules.purpose: async HTTP process await network cancellation cleanup
modules.ownership: Module policy: adapters retain owned operations until terminal release.
modules.limits: Typed operation/cleanup failures; blocking arbitrary io is rejected.

modules.purpose: HTTP loopback server requests responses handler network
modules.ownership: Module policy: Windows DLL owns listener/queue/callback; close explicitly.
modules.limits: Loopback bounded GET/HEAD server; explicit content_type; no request bodies.

modules.purpose: GUI window form controls events user interface
modules.ownership: Module policy: Window aliases share idempotent close and native callback/queue.
modules.limits: Windows trusted vela-gui.dll; drain tasks before window close.

modules.purpose: typed CLI command line arguments options flags help defaults integer bounds positional schema параметры аргументы
modules.ownership: Module policy: opaque schema snapshots descriptors; parsed values are private; input arguments are preserved.
modules.limits: 64 descriptors/relations, 4096 arguments; inclusive Int ranges; no library I/O, current adds args.

modules.purpose: Result map and_then short circuit eager lazy default unwrap typed error context причина ошибка
modules.ownership: Module policy: ordinary payload aliases; callbacks are synchronous, called zero/one time and never retained.
modules.limits: O(1) plus callback; unwrap_or eagerly evaluates default; unwrap_or_else invokes recover only on Err.

modules.purpose: Option map and_then Some None optional eager lazy defaults unwrap
modules.ownership: Module policy: ordinary payload aliases; synchronous callbacks are not retained; Some/None selects zero/one call.
modules.limits: O(1) plus callback; unwrap_or is eager, unwrap_or_else produces only for None.

modules.purpose: stable generic sort comparator ordering records collection map filter transform fold reduce find any all predicate try typed failure ошибка обход сортировка
modules.ownership: Module policy: fresh shallow outer snapshot; nested mutable payloads stay shared; comparator is not retained.
modules.limits: Sort requires strict weak ordering and <=n*ceil(log2(n)) comparisons; traversals <=n calls; eager O(n) snapshot even on short circuit; state plus callback effects; first typed error stops.

modules.purpose: set membership unique deduplicate union intersection difference ordered keys множество уникальные ключи
modules.ownership: Module policy: Set copies share Dict/order-list identity; values and binary algebra results have independent outer storage.
modules.limits: Existing Dict key types Int/Bool/String and distinct wrappers; state required; expected hash costs, removal O(n), no worst-case O(1) promise.

modules.purpose: shared mutable value cell get set state closure capture ячейка разделяемое состояние
modules.ownership: Module policy: copies/captures share opaque one-slot identity; nested payloads keep ordinary aliases; no native resource ownership.
modules.limits: O(1) container work; state required for create/get/set; no public internal List, atomics or cross-thread transfer.

modules.purpose: typed JSON record schema decoder required optional default nullable array integer range unknown fields путь ошибка JSON декодер
modules.ownership: Module policy: opaque immutable span maps retain input backing; typed stateful builders run after syntax validation; payloads use ordinary aliases, no resource rollback.
modules.limits: Input <=16 MiB/depth4096/nodes1000000 via json_stream; selected decoder nesting128; arrays65536/fields256/key1024/outer path65536; first typed error stops.

modules.purpose: synchronous byte Reader Writer memory file copy short reads writes EOF close поток копирование
modules.ownership: Opaque shared cursor/failure/close; borrowed copy, copy_owned preserves operation and both cleanup causes; explicit close required.
modules.limits: buffer 1..65536, positive Int64 total; file read chunks <=8192; old 256 MiB stream cap unchanged. Typed sticky errors, no retry/rollback.

modules.purpose: typed streaming lines UTF8 BOM CRLF record byte offset bounded строка поток
modules.ownership: Opaque shared line cursor borrows io Reader; close explicitly closes shared source; retains current bounded record/chunks only.
modules.limits: record 1..1048576, buffer 1..65536; total via io Reader. Typed error category, physical byte offset, 1-based line and unchanged io cause.

modules.purpose: bounded parallel async map ordered results concurrency cancellation deadline fail fast collect queue параллельно отмена очередь
modules.ownership: Job copies share explicit host-driven lifecycle. Snapshot outer input; per-item Scope owns child operations. Tick after cancel until drained outcome. Fresh outer completion lists, nested aliases ordinary.
modules.limits: concurrency 1..128, inputs <=65536; overall queue-inclusive timeout <=2147483647; at most one group turn/tick, no sleep. Fibers/HTTP Windows only; typed errors and all cleanup causes retained.
